hooks.logic:
If not the script register's 'single_check_completion', then
  Let aliveChildren be the living parts of the acting enemy.
  If the length of aliveChildren is not 1, then stop.
  Let v be aliveChildren at 0.
  If the value "no" of v is not 1, then
    Let currentParamSuffixNo be the current form of v.
    V changes to form data at currentParamSuffixNo.
    V cancels its cast.
  Set the script register's 'single_check_completion' to true.

yes.text: Let aliveChildren be the living parts of the acting enemy.
the length of aliveChildren is not 1
the value "no" of v is not 1
Let currentParamSuffixNo be the current form of v.
V changes to form data at currentParamSuffixNo.
Set the script register's 'single_check_completion' to true.
